The transfer order is saved as a draft.
Flyttordern är skickad. Varorna är på vä: The transfer order is sent. The goods are on their way.
Flyttordern är avbruten. Det som var på: The transfer order is cancelled. What was on its way is back with the sender.
Beställningspunkten för lagret är sparad: The reorder point for the warehouse is saved.
Beställningspunkten för lagret är bortta: The reorder point for the warehouse is removed.
Choose the warehouse the goods are sent from.
Choose the warehouse the goods are sent to.
Choose an article on every row.
Only a draft can be changed.
The transfer order has already been sent.
There is nothing on its way to receive.
Det är bara :open kvar på väg på den rad: Only :open is still on its way on that row.
The transfer order cannot be cancelled.
Välj ett lagerställe, inte platsen för v: Choose a location, not the place for goods in transit.
Choose a location in another warehouse. Inside one warehouse you move the goods directly.
Flytta varor mellan lager. De väntar på: Move goods between warehouses. They wait in transit until they are received, and stay in the stock value the whole time.
Välj platsen där varorna ligger och plat: Choose the place where the goods are and the place in the other warehouse they are going to. The warehouses must differ.
Batch väljs när ordern skickas (bäst för: The batch is chosen when the order is sent (best-before first).
Skicka flyttordern? Varorna tas från avs: Send the transfer order? The goods are taken from the sender and wait in transit until they are received. It can only be corrected with a new movement.
Skicka, varorna är på väg: Send, the goods are on their way
Cancel the transfer order? Nothing has been moved.
Ta emot det som kom fram? Det läggs in p: Receive what arrived? It is put into the receiving location. What did not arrive stays in transit.
Avbryta resten? Det som fortfarande är p: Cancel the rest? What is still on its way is sent back to the sender's location.
Avbryt resten, tillbaka till avsändaren: Cancel the rest, back to the sender
Gör en flyttorder när varor ska från ett: Make a transfer order when goods go from one warehouse to another. While they are on their way they still count in the stock value.
Per lager, efter de beställningspunkter: Per warehouse, by the reorder points set on the articles. What is on its way there counts.
Sätts en punkt för ett lager bedöms arti: When a point is set for a warehouse, the purchase proposal judges the article warehouse by warehouse and the reorder point above is no longer used. What is on its way to the warehouse counts.
Ta bort beställningspunkten för lagret?: Remove the reorder point for the warehouse?
Valfritt. Lagret räknas som en enhet gen: Optional. The warehouse counts as a unit through its cost centre, so a member limited to the cost centre belongs with the warehouse.
Lagerstället för varor på väg används ba: The place for goods in transit is used only by transfer orders.
:code ingår i en flyttorder som är på vä: :code is part of a transfer order that is on its way. Receive or cancel it first.
Platsen för varor på väg skapas av syste: The place for goods in transit is made by the system and cannot be changed.
